card.name: Mineral and vitamin intake and absorption
card.fires_on: Words in label text about minerals, vitamins or tetracycline-calcium binding, where the next word may relate to dietary intake, absorption or plasma levels. Seen on 'in' after calcium complex, and on 'Large' or 'Long' opening a dose phrase.

modes.label: Calcium binding
modes.description: The word 'in' right after 'stable calcium complex' in tetracycline bone warnings.
modes.example: All tetracyclines form a stable calcium complex<< in>> any bone-forming tissue.

modes.label: Large or long dosing
modes.description: Opening words such as 'Large' or 'Long' before doses or therapy of vitamins and PPIs.

modes.label: Scattered stray spots
modes.description: Odd positions such as a citation year digit or a word like 'recommended' in fluoride levels.
modes.example: an amount within<< recommended>> levels adversely affecting functions of the nervous system

card.plain: It fires where the text is about how much of a vitamin or mineral is taken in or absorbed.
